title: Kaise Chale Hussain ka beemaar dhoop me
body:
Haaye Sajjad Haaye Beemar
Haaye Beemar Haaye Sajjad*2
Kaise Chale Hussain Ka Beemar Dhoop Me*2
<<DIVIDER>>
Aao Madad Ko Hydar E Karrar Dhoop Me
<<MINI>>
Kaise Chale Hussain Ka Beemar Dhoop Me*2
<<DIVIDER>>
1)
Rasta Bad a Taweel Hai Zakmi Hai Yediya'n
Zanjeer Itni Garm Hai Jalti Hai Pindliya'n
Jhulsa Raha Hai Tauqe Gara Bar Dhoop Me
<<MINI>>
Kaise Chale Hussain Ka Beemar Dhoop Me*2
<<DIVIDER>>
2)
Chidkao Karte Jaate Hain Aansu Hussain Ke
Pairo' N Ko Kuch Sukoon Mile Noor E Ain Ke
Be Sayebaa'n Hai Qafila Saalar Dhoop Me
<<MINI>>
Kaise Chale Hussain Ka Beemar Dhoop Me*2
<<DIVIDER>>
3)
Na Mehramo'n Ki Bheed Hai Chehra Nidhaal Hai
Phupiyo'n Ki Beridayi Ka Itna Malal Hai
Aata Hai Ghash Mareez Ko Har Baar Dhoop Me
<<MINI>>
Kaise Chale Hussain Ka Beemar Dhoop Me*2
<<DIVIDER>>
4)
Zakhmi Hai Saara Jism Ghamo'n Ki Satayi Ka
Dil Kaamp Kaamp Jata Hai Seene Me Bhai Ka
Durre Layee'n Sakina ke Mat Maar Dhoop Me
<<MINI>>
Kaise Chale Hussain Ka Beemar Dhoop Me*2
<<DIVIDER>>
5)
Abid Ke Paun Raah Me Chaalo'n Se Bhargaye
Jaldi Zamee'n Ne Saath Na Chorda Jidhar Gaye
Aisa Huwa Naseeb Giraftaar Dhoop Me
<<MINI>>
Kaise Chale Hussain Ka Beemar Dhoop Me*2
<<DIVIDER>>
6)
Kam Karle Tu Hi Apni Tamazat Ko Aftab
Dena Padega Hashr Me Peshe Khuda Jawab
Hai Saath Binte Ahmad E Mukhtar Dhoop Me
<<MINI>>
Kaise Chale Hussain Ka Beemar Dhoop Me*2
<<DIVIDER>>
7)
Naize Pe Sar Hussain Ka IsGham Se Hai Udaas
Koi Nahi Hai Abid E Muztar Ke Aaspas
Ek Ghamzada Phupi Hai Madadgaar Dhoop Me
<<MINI>>
Kaise Chale Hussain Ka Beemar Dhoop Me*2
<<DIVIDER>>
8)
Mushkil Badi Hai "Aamir" O "Akhtar" Mareez Par
Hasnte Hain Raasto'n Me Sitam Gar Dhoop Me
Hai Ab To Saans Lena Bhi Dushwaar Dhoop Me
<<MINI>>
Kaise Chale Hussain Ka Beemar Dhoop Me*2.
